newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan imports first Alaskan crude in August- MITI.
newsitem.headline: Japan imports first Alaskan crude in August- MITI.

text.p: Japan imported 206,354 kilolitres (kl) of Alaskan crude oil in August, marking the first ever imports from the state and the first crude imports from the United States since 1973, the trade ministry said on Thursday.

The imports were by refiner Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd which announced in June its decision to import 1.3 million barrels (about 206,354 kl) of Alaskan North Slope (ANS) crude for August arrival. The move follows a decision by the United States in April to lift a 23-year export ban on Alaskan crude.
Refiner Cosmo Oil Co Ltd has also unveiled plans to import 800,000 barrels of ANS for September arrival.
